hero.title: Exploring the Breakthroughs, Technologies, and Techniques Transforming Aesthetic Medicine
hero.subtitle: A dynamic, single-day conference dedicated to scientific discovery, education, thought-provoking debate, and advancements in our field that you won't want to miss.

about.title:
Founded by leaders.
Focused on innovation.
about.body: INNOVATE was founded out of a shared passion for scientific discovery and clinical excellence. For Dr. Arjang Yazdani, plastic surgeon, that passion lies in developing and refining surgical techniques that lead to better patient outcomes. For Nadine Sabino, RN, it's about exploring the potential of advanced laser technologies and pushing the boundaries of non-surgical treatments. United by a relentless pursuit of better technologies, techniques, and results, they created a forum where leading minds can exchange ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and explore the advancements shaping the future of aesthetic medicine.
highlights: Showcase the latest advancements and innovations shaping the future of medical aesthetics.
Provide a platform for industry leaders to introduce new technologies and products launching in 2027
Encourage informed debate and critical evaluation of emerging trends, evolving techniques, and approaches that are challenging conventional thinking in aesthetic medicine.
